name: Elena Rossi
bio: Elena sets the company’s direction and helps departments resolve decisions that cross their boundaries. She stays close to customer outcomes while leaving routine decisions with the people who own them.
responsibilities: Company strategy, business priorities, and decisions spanning multiple department leads.
Subscription discounts above 20%, jointly with Daniel Brooks in Finance.
Escalated business trade-offs and exceptional commercial risk. Routine sales, people, and operations questions go to the responsible department lead.
